text:
maya: prepping EU change window for 2024-03-22 06:00 UTC. i'm about to take the preflight SLO snapshot. who else should I include?
kevin: include p95 per-route, p99 embeds, 5xx rate, error-budget burn, kv-cache miss, streaming tail latency, seq-len heatmap.
nana: +reranker 4xx->5xx conversion and model fallback counts. last night we saw reranker CAP errors.
sam: also the orchestration queue depth metric for gpu-nodes, and kernel-fallback counters. we had a couple of weird fallbacks earlier.
sre-bot: AUTO_ALERT: simulated spike detected on embed-route p95 in eu-west. baseline 110ms -> 160ms over the last 40m. sample trace id trace-eu-113.
maya: did staging get a variant roll?
kevin: quantize-v2.1.4-rc3 rolled to staging around 02:45 UTC. no prod push.
nana: pulling the trace now. query: trace.id=trace-eu-113 for kernel_fallback events and kv latencies.
kevin: logs show kernel fallback spikes on gpu-node-09 with elevated CPU wait and stretched KV fetch times. minor 502 tail but predominantly longer tails.
maya: proposal: hold the EU traffic shift and pin eu-embed to the previous stable v2.1.4-rc2 for the change window. run kernel regression matrix on rc3 overnight.
sam: agree. also recommend we add a short mitigation runbook to the ticket so ops can quickly test unpin and emergency rollback paths.
deploy-bot: pin action recorded by @maya: route=eu-embed, pinned_version=v2.1.4-rc2, reason="staging p95 regress with rc3 kernel fallbacks". ticket: RED-4219. link: https://issues.redwood/RED-4219
sre-bot: running quick smoke on pinned version (2k samples): p95=112ms, 5xx=0.05%, kv-miss=1.9% -> smoke OK.
kevin: plan: 1) update release notes & changelog indicating hold + pin, 2) run kernel regression and perf matrix on rc3 overnight, 3) re-evaluate at 04:30 UTC and post final snapshot.
maya: drafting release note: "EU change window: traffic shift held. eu-embed pinned to v2.1.4-rc2 pending runtime kernel regression for rc3 (see RED-4219)."
sam: add unpin and emergency rollback commands to the release notes: `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2` and `deploy-bot rollback --route eu-embed --to-version v2.1.4-rc2 --force` respectively.
nana: notify platform-ops and add short blurb to the changelog so oncall sees it during the window.
maya: decision: no traffic shift until re-eval at 05:00 UTC. if metrics stable then proceed with controlled ramp: 10% after green, then 30%, then full. abort criteria: p95 > 1.25x baseline OR 5xx rate > 0.5% OR kernel-fallback-rate > 2x baseline.
deploy-bot: ramp_policy saved on RED-4219: {10,30,100} with abort_criteria as above.
sre-bot: tagging oncall @kevin @ana @sam please ack the HOLD and keep an eye on overnight regression runs. i'll post the 04:30 snapshot and the 05:00 go/no-go.
kevin: ack.
nana: ack.
sam: ack. i'll spin up the kernel regression matrix and post results to the ticket.
maya: thanks all. i'll merge the release notes PR with the hold note and pin info, and add the unpin cmds. closing this thread for now, will update after 04:30 UTC snapshot.
(END)
